text:
Indra: Heads-up — I hit a 404 in the oncall runbook at /runbooks/oncall/fast-restart.md. The 'service-restart' anchor seems to point to a deleted heading. Who owns this runbook? cc @sara

sara: I can take this. Looks like the heading was renamed in last week's PR (forgot to update the anchor). Is this blocking anything in prod?

tom_k: I’m about to step out for lunch in ~10m but can review a tiny PR. @eli can you check the curl verification snippet under 'verify' — I think the example host variable is stale.

eli: I’ll review in ~30m. Also spotted a broken link to the Grafana dashboard (internal/grafana/oncall) while scanning the page.

Indra: Not blocking prod right now, but the oncall flow could confuse responders — marking as P1 for docs tidy. Quick fix suggestion (sed) to update the anchor name locally:
```
sed -i 's/#service-restart/#restart-service/g' runbooks/oncall/fast-restart.md
```

docs-bot: automated-link-scan detected the broken anchor and created issue #987 in the docs repo (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/987).

sara: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — fixes the anchor and updates the Grafana link, plus a tiny curl example tweak. @tom_k when you’re back could you please take a look? :pray:

tom_k: reviewing now — left one inline nit about backticks around the curl command but otherwise looks solid.

eli: LGTM after the nit. Would prefer if we also add a short link-check test for that runbook path so this doesn't slip again. Happy to add it as a follow-up if someone prefers a separate PR.

Indra: good call. @docs-bot can you enqueue a staging link-check run after the PR merges?

docs-bot: scheduled link-check job for staging; results will post to #docs-ci when complete.

sara: merged PR and deployed to staging — link-check passed, all links/anchors are green :white_check_mark:. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Indra: awesome, thanks @sara, @tom_k, @eli. Follow-up: add link-check unit for /runbooks/oncall/fast-restart.md (tracking in issue #988).
